changelog:
1.2.1

  • Readable buttons in admin notices.
  • TranslatePress: logo renders, dark action tab.
  • Squirrly pages no longer draw boxes around the sidebar.
  • Neutral Site Health accents.

1.1.1

  • Dropdown menus no longer close while moving the pointer into them.
  • The profile menu anchors to the sidebar corner instead of floating away.

1.1.0

  • Toolbar dropdowns open below the bar as proper menus.
  • Consistent toolbar spacing, crisp icons, keyboard chip, clean search button.
  • Neutral palette on plugin pages (links, tabs, form controls).
  • Theme cards get breathing room.
  • Rounded sidebar logo.

1.0.0

  • First release: four toggleable wp-admin fixes for uiXpress and Core Framework conflicts.
